propositions: Reconciler reports exit 0 and 'OK: applied N of N' even when sub-operations silently fail because partial comment errors are recorded non-fatally and never counted in mutation_failures
Silent no-op canary only hard-fails behind RECONCILER_FAIL_SILENT_NOOP flag (default off), allowing failures to be demoted to warn-only
Partial comment failures are swallowed at the transport floor (acli_subprocess._check_mutation_failure) and demoted to non-fatal comment_errors instead of being surfaced
When RECONCILER_FAIL_SILENT_NOOP=1, comment_errors must set outcome[error] so partial comment drops count toward mutation_failures and drive non-zero exit
Flag must remain off by default and activated only after Jira comment cleanup to avoid failing on still-capped tickets with ~7 unsynced comments each
